scenarios.note: The rule was implemented as a closure inside cmd/axisscore's text renderer, so nothing could execute it and nothing else could reuse it. Extracted to core/axis.ZeroNumeratorBound (+ the numeric ZeroNumeratorUpperBound for gauge callers) and driven by four oracles: the bare-zero refusal, the bound shrinking with n (the property a bare zero hides), the empty-sample vacuity floor in BOTH the string and numeric forms, and the requirement's own worked example 0-of-12 = 25%.
